findings.evidence: 444 rows affected out of 505 (e.g., respondent R0001 with GAD-7 total 1.0 is incorrectly labeled 'mild' instead of 'minimal').
findings.description: The pipeline assigns GAD-7 severity bands using PHQ-9 severity categories ('mild', 'moderate', 'moderately severe', 'severe') and incorrect cutpoints (0-5 mild, 6-10 moderate, 11-15 moderately severe, 16-21 severe) instead of the correct GAD-7 cutpoints (0-4 minimal, 5-9 mild, 10-14 moderate, 15-21 severe).
